tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1972 年发布
description: 美能达于1972年推出的旁轴相机。配备1:2.7/38mm (4 elements)。快门速度4 - 1/724 sec. ( 1/20 sec. with flash )。

specs.曝光测光: CdS-meter coupled with shutter, meter window within the filter connection ring
specs.英文简介: In 1972 Minolta released a new version of their Hi-Matic consumer rangefinder cameras, the HI-MATIC F, with the less sophisticated 38mm (f2.7) Rokkor lens.
